SELECT 
    `i_item_id`, 
    `s_state`, 
    GROUPING(`s_state`) AS g_state, 
    AVG(`ss_quantity`) AS agg1, 
    AVG(`ss_list_price`) AS agg2, 
    AVG(`ss_coupon_amt`) AS agg3, 
    AVG(`ss_sales_price`) AS agg4 
FROM 
    store_sales 
JOIN 
    (SELECT `cd_demo_sk` FROM `customer_demographics` WHERE `cd_gender` = 'M' AND `cd_marital_status` = 'W' AND `cd_education_status` = 'Secondary') AS filtered_demographics ON `store_sales`.`ss_cdemo_sk` = `filtered_demographics`.`cd_demo_sk` 
JOIN 
    (SELECT `s_store_sk`, `s_state` FROM `store` WHERE `s_state` = 'TN') AS filtered_store ON `store_sales`.`ss_store_sk` = `filtered_store`.`s_store_sk` 
JOIN 
    `date_dim` ON `store_sales`.`ss_sold_date_sk` = `date_dim`.`d_date_sk` 
JOIN 
    `item` ON `store_sales`.`ss_item_sk` = `item`.`i_item_sk` 
WHERE 
    `date_dim`.`d_year` = 1999 
GROUP BY 
    ROLLUP (`i_item_id`, `s_state`) 
ORDER BY 
    `i_item_id`, 
    `s_state` 
LIMIT 100
